headline: Pasqal Thoughts 2026: Vela (256q) launching 2026 for quantum advantage; Canada PINQ2 access; $2B SPAC
details: Announced at Pasqal Thoughts 2026 (Apr 20-21, World Quantum Day). Vela QPU: 256 high-quality qubits, first QPU engineered for quantum advantage specs, launching 2026. Canada (PINQ2/DistriQ): exclusive distributor, Orion Alpha 100q access since Apr 2026. SPAC merger with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp II at $2B valuation. Research: optimization, materials, protein design.
relevance_reason: Vela 256q neutral atom QPU in 2026 is a direct path for large-system MERA experiments. Canada (PINQ2) provides a North American academic access route. 256q exceeds our current 16q experiments significantly.
